AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneLocusDef.label: growth
AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneLocusDef.description: How fast the plant matures. Divides the grow time by the factor shown.

AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneLocusDef.label: yield
AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneLocusDef.description: How much the plant gives at harvest.

AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneLocusDef.label: fertility response
AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneLocusDef.description:
How strongly growth follows soil fertility (fertility sensitivity, +10% per level).

Positive: grows much faster on rich soil and in hydroponics, but worse on poor soil.
Negative: steady growth everywhere, little benefit from rich ground.

Costs genome capacity in either direction.

AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneLocusDef.label: soil tolerance
AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneLocusDef.description: The minimum soil fertility the plant can be sown in (-8 percentage points per level). Separate from fertility response: a tolerant plant can be sown on poor ground, how well it grows there depends on its fertility response.

AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneLocusDef.label: light efficiency
AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneLocusDef.description: How little light the plant needs. Lowers the minimum light level (-6 points per level) and the light level for full growth.

AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneLocusDef.label: cold tolerance
AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneLocusDef.description: Lowers the minimum growing temperatures by 3°C per level. Longer growing seasons in cold climates.

AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneLocusDef.label: heat tolerance
AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneLocusDef.description: Raises the maximum growing temperatures by 3°C per level.

AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneLocusDef.label: blight resistance
AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneLocusDef.description: 10% chance per level to shrug off blight. At +10 the plant can't be blighted at all.\n\nNegative levels are free: they don't refund capacity.

AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneLocusDef.label: vigor
AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneLocusDef.description: Longevity: +20% lifespan per level, and regrowing plants (and perennials) come back further after harvest.
